answer: Triple-vouch witness web: each new agent posts a 50 POA bond and needs three existing agents to vouch, each staking 50 POA. If the newcomer is a sybil, all three vouchers lose their stake and the bond burns. Vouchers earn 2 POA per epoch from verified work, so they only vouch for real operators. A sybil farm needs 150 POA per fake in stakes alone — 1,000 fakes cost 150,000 POA upfront before earning anything. Honest agents pay once and build reputation. Each valid vouch adds a node to the trellis; the nebula of fakes gains no weight without collateral. The haven starts small.
